cards.entity: Microorganisms and methods for the production of fatty acids and fatty acid derived products
cards.claim: Microorganisms capable of producing fatty acids and fatty acid-derived products played a crucial role in the recent volcanic eruption on the island of Hawaii.
cards.answer: recent volcanic eruption on the island of Hawaii
cards.quote: Maria Rodriguez, a team of researchers from the University of California, Berkeley, found that microorganisms capable of producing fatty acids and fatty acid-derived products played a crucial role in the recent volcanic eruption on the island of Hawaii.
